source_access.saint_germain: Publisher contents/imprint only; obtain authorized pp20–38 for first spatial system and p63 if gemstone subset chosen.
source_access.wimmer: Author web roles complete and legitimate selected-preview text available. Original printing and omitted pp88–125 spatial/timing/boundary procedures not inspected. Preview images need reliable visual access.
source_access.howard: Publisher metadata verified; exact book pages gated. Public author web guide is an independently named witness, not a substitute silently attributed to the book.
source_access.rights: Modern text, correspondence lists, photos and diagrams retain author/publisher rights. Public author preview is access permission, not a redistribution license. Original concise facts and locators only; no chapter corpus or images bundled.

wimmer.identity: Author-assigned roles; stone mineral/appearance not a universal required mapping. Astrological Sun/Moon terminology is source nomenclature.

howard_web.limits: Audit identities only; complete original concise associations and row locators must be independently frozen before executable catalog. The separate work-change sea-set has different objects/personal stone; never mix its meanings into the general set.

source_set_investigation.thirteen: Original variation retained; no source-verified complete thirteen-role profile frozen. Secondary generic lists are not substitutes for ranked source inspection.

spatial_investigation.casting: Manual labelled placements first; real/hypothetical/synthetic provenance explicit. Drop/toss instructions do not specify a probability distribution.
spatial_investigation.surface: Wimmer material circle differs from Howard general mat; do not transfer circle boundaries to all sources.
spatial_investigation.coordinates: Application convention must declare origin, axes, scale, user viewpoint and point-centre versus stone footprint. Sources inspected do not supply a universal Cartesian coordinate system.
spatial_investigation.distance: Howard nearest priority can support a named relative-distance comparison. Numeric metric, ties, tolerance and observer position are editorial choices to freeze explicitly, not claimed historical cutoffs.
spatial_investigation.clusters: User-selected groups can be documented. Do not invent a radius, automatic cluster threshold or merged semantic outcome from qualitative proximity.
spatial_investigation.orientation: Arrow-marked item orientation needs separately verified rule; arrow mark alone does not establish where it points or its effect.
spatial_investigation.boundary: Wimmer contents list under/on/outside circle pp114–116 but text not inspected. Equality/touching/partial overlap and under-cord meaning remain unsupported until source and representation frozen.
spatial_investigation.timing: Wimmer describes a three-month reading context; clock/time conversion and the missing chapters are not verified. No dates or real event forecast inferred.
spatial_investigation.combinations: Maintain each source’s own identities, conditional relations and exceptions; user association distinct from direct source summaries and editorial geometry.

proposed_manual_contract.validation: Require finite bounded coordinates; reject booleans, missing/duplicate identities, mixed-source roles and contradictory frame declarations. Unknown location remains unknown. Overlap, coincidence, ties and incomplete sets need explicit policies.
proposed_manual_contract.outputs: Set inventory, raw positions, source identities/meanings, exact spatial condition traces, tie/unknown evidence, direct/compositional/user/unsupported layers and portable hashes/full replay inJSON/Markdown.
proposed_manual_contract.reuse: Generic strict JSON, raw Unicode, immutable registry/hash/report and pure coordinate helpers only. No tea/coffee symbol interpretation, cup zones, handle orientation, spill timing, RNG output or Geomancy figure rules imported.
proposed_manual_contract.synthetic: Optional later domain-separated protocol must freeze labelled position distribution, replacement/overlap/boundary policy, integer-to-coordinate mapping and independent known-answer vectors. Sampling a uniform radius is not uniform area; no source ritual distribution may be implied. No physics, UI or protocol implemented.

Test unknown/missing stones, mixed-source IDs, boundaries only if independently sourced, raw Unicode, strict input rejection and deterministic replay.
Future seeded protocol requires independent vectors/distribution specification; manual release does not require synthetic casting.

Separate incompatible sets and preserve original three rankings/four variations; no universal thirteen-stone claim.
Offline strict JSON/Markdown, raw text/origin preservation, immutable hashes and full replay.
Preserve689 inherited tests,783 CLI cases,16 symbolic verifiers and all prior engines/profiles/RNG/report bytes; complete regression, CLI, registry, dependency, pip and diff checks before readiness.
